entry.title: flophouse — Urban Dictionary
entry.content:
Any house/apartment/frat house/trailer/etc. which is used for individuals to crash (sleep, chill, hang out, lurk, etc.) for a period of time. entry.title: jody — Urban Dictionary
entry.content: The hypothetical man (often a sinister character who decided not to go to boot camp) that is doing your girlfriend/wife while you are on deployment overseas.
